adjudication.rationale: The server-side input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` only validates `guests` as an array of emails and does not enforce uniqueness. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails, but it does not dedupe duplicates within the same `guests` array. Those duplicates are then passed to `createMany` (`guestsFullDetails`), which can create duplicate attendee rows (or cause a DB error) and can also trigger duplicate/incorrect email sending (`sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` uses the original non-deduped `guests`). The UI dialog does a uniqueness refine, but the server cannot rely on client validation.
